text: こんどこそ　ちゃんと　おうちに　かえらなくっちゃ！

structure.jp: ちゃんと　おうちに　かえらなくっちゃ！
structure.en: I have to get home properly!

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: なくっちゃ is a chatty short form of なくてはならない, 'must'; the ending is simply dropped. かえらなくっちゃ = 'I've got to go home'.

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it: this one and no other. こんどこそ = 'this time for sure'.
